report.summary: daedalus/file_bridge.py: Implements the file-bridge protocol for enqueuing and processing task requests with exactly-once semantics, crash safety via journaling, heartbeat monitoring, and quarantine for failed requests.
risks: DEPENDS daedalus/file_bridge.py daedalus.memory
DEPENDS daedalus/file_bridge.py daedalus.projects
DEPENDS daedalus/file_bridge.py daedalus.spine
WRITES daedalus/file_bridge.py outbox directory (via enqueue)
WRITES daedalus/file_bridge.py inbox directory (via process_request, quarantine_request)
WRITES daedalus/file_bridge.py archive directory (via process_request, quarantine_request)
WRITES daedalus/file_bridge.py runs/bridge_heartbeat.json (external, not in this file)
WRITES daedalus/file_bridge.py inbox/LATEST.log (via _note_report_arrival)
WRITES daedalus/file_bridge.py archive/.journal/*.json (via _write_journal)
WRITES daedalus/file_bridge.py archive/quarantine/*.json (via quarantine_request)

READS daedalus/file_bridge.py inbox/*.report.json (via _completed_report)

CLAIMS daedalus/file_bridge.py WatcherNotRunning: raised by enqueue() when no watcher is alive
CLAIMS daedalus/file_bridge.py enqueue: drops one task request into the outbox with trace and consumer check
CLAIMS daedalus/file_bridge.py process_request: processes one request exactly once across crashes
CLAIMS daedalus/file_bridge.py quarantine_request: takes a request out of watcher's way permanently and visibly
CLAIMS daedalus/file_bridge.py codex_inline_brief_warning: returns warning when codex-lane objective smells like inline brief

daedalus/file_bridge.py|class|WatcherNotRunning|Raised by enqueue() when no watcher is alive to consume the request.
